settings.scope: Pure dilute-gas viscosity and first-order binary molecular diffusion only; explicit zero-dipole LJ approximation. No mixture-viscosity, porous effective diffusivity, Darcy permeability, multicomponent flux, Soret or brick qualification. GRI NASA thermo and reactions are not imported. No post-fit calibration to NIST tables. NIST comparison pressure is unspecified on selected pages; agreement is not pressure-matched experimental validation.
